description: This PHP source file defines the class ConditionalDataBarExtension, which is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library handling conditional formatting data bars in spreadsheets. The class manages properties related to data bar formatting such as lengths, colors, directions, and other visual attributes, along with methods to get/set these properties and to generate XML attributes/elements corresponding to spreadsheet formatting.

classes.name: ConditionalDataBarExtension
classes.description: Represents the extension data for a data bar in conditional formatting within PHPSpreadsheet, including properties for visual attributes and methods to serialize to XML.

methods.name: getXmlAttributes
methods.description: Returns an associative array of XML attributes based on the data bar's properties, such as minLength, maxLength, direction, axis position, border, and gradient.

methods.name: getXmlElements
methods.description: Returns an associative array of XML elements representing color properties (borderColor, negativeFillColor, negativeBorderColor) and axis color options for the data bar.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Gets the minimum length setting of the data bar.

methods.name: setMinLength
methods.description: Sets the minimum length setting of the data bar.

methods.name: getMaxLength
methods.description: Gets the maximum length setting of the data bar.

methods.name: setMaxLength
methods.description: Sets the maximum length setting of the data bar.

methods.name: getBorder
methods.description: Gets the border visibility setting for the data bar.

methods.name: setBorder
methods.description: Sets the border visibility for the data bar.

methods.name: getGradient
methods.description: Gets whether gradient fill is enabled for the data bar.

methods.name: setGradient
methods.description: Enables or disables gradient fill for the data bar.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Retrieves the direction of the data bar.

methods.name: setDirection
methods.description: Sets the direction of the data bar.

methods.name: getNegativeBarBorderColorSameAsPositive
methods.description: Returns whether the negative bar border color is the same as the positive bar.

methods.name: setNegativeBarBorderColorSameAsPositive
methods.description: Sets whether the negative bar border color should be the same as positive.

methods.name: getAxisPosition
methods.description: Gets the axis position setting.

methods.name: setAxisPosition
methods.description: Sets the axis position.

methods.name: getMaximumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Gets the maximum conditional format value object.

methods.name: setMaximumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Sets the maximum conditional format value object.

methods.name: getMinimumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Gets the minimum conditional format value object.

methods.name: setMinimumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Sets the minimum conditional format value object.

methods.name: getBorderColor
methods.description: Gets the border color.

methods.name: setBorderColor
methods.description: Sets the border color.

methods.name: getNegativeFillColor
methods.description: Gets the fill color for negative values.

methods.name: setNegativeFillColor
methods.description: Sets the fill color for negative values.

methods.name: getNegativeBorderColor
methods.description: Gets the border color for negative values.

methods.name: setNegativeBorderColor
methods.description: Sets the border color for negative values.

methods.name: getAxisColor
methods.description: Retrieves the axis color settings as an array.

methods.name: setAxisColor
methods.description: Sets the axis color using rgb, theme, and tint parameters.
